title: Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements — Schedule of Term, Renewal and Termination
content:
Term length, renewal and mid-term cancellation figures for each tier of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements.

| Tier | Term length (calendar months) | Renews unless notice is given | Non-renewal notice (calendar days before term end) | Written notice to cancel mid-term (calendar days) | Early termination fee (percent) | Unused annual fee prorated back on mid-term cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 12 | Yes | 0 | 0 | 0 | No |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 12 | Yes | 30 | 30 | 0 | No |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 12 | Yes | 30 | 30 | 25 | Yes |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 12 | Yes | 60 | 30 | 25 | Yes |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 12 | No | 90 | 60 | 25 | Yes |
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 24 | No | 90 | 90 | 0 | No |

## Definitions

1. **Term length** is the length of one agreement term in calendar months.
2. **Renews unless notice is given** states whether the agreement renews for another term unless notice is given.
3. **Non-renewal notice** is the number of calendar days before the term end by which non-renewal notice must be given.
4. **Written notice to cancel mid-term** is the number of calendar days of written notice required to cancel mid-term.
5. **Early termination fee** is the share of the unbilled remainder of the term's site fees charged on mid-term cancellation, in percent.
6. **Unused annual fee prorated back** states whether the unused part of the annual fee is prorated back on mid-term cancellation.

## Comparisons drawn from the schedule

- Every tier runs 12-month terms except the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement, whose term is 24 months.
- The Portfolio Master Service Agreement and the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement do not renew by default; the four other tiers do.
- An early termination fee of 25 percent appears at the Gold Priority, Platinum Priority and Portfolio Master tiers, which are also the tiers whose unused annual fee is prorated back; the Ready Profile, Silver Priority and Carrier Preferred Vendor tiers show 0 percent and no proration.
